rationale: Dispatching two drones to high-risk, densely occupied blocks with up to 65% collapse probability that the helicopter could not assess or has not reached. D1 will survey the One Sansome Street URM-infill block (~9,019 occupants), while D2 will inspect the 32 Battery St URM-infill block (~1,162 occupants) where AIR 1 had no visibility. D3 is held in reserve for follow-up on newly discovered collapses.

missions.purpose: Survey the One Sansome Street URM-infill block for predicted collapses and trapped occupants.
Assess the 32 Battery St URM-infill block where helicopter views were obstructed.
